title: Hambani Ngwenya and Anor v Lubambe Copper Mine Limited (SCZ/7/15/2025) [2025] ZMSC 31 (28 October 2025)
case_name: Hambani Ngwenya and Anor v Lubambe Copper Mine Limited
outcome_detail: Leave to appeal granted; points of law of public importance disclosed — whether arbitral tribunal may entertain Employment Code Act s 5 claims (unfair discrimination), whether s 5 is confined to criminal law, and whether non-parties' employment contracts may be used as comparators in arbitration.
